title: UI/UX enhance across catalog and docs surfaces

questions.prompt: Which surfaces are in-scope, in polish order?
questions.description: Audits already ran. Catalog is the awesome web app (no-bundler HTML/CSS/JS). docs/ is GFM handbook, not a site. Starlight may use Tailwind tokens. Generated plugins must not receive catalog identity. Origin github.com is still a stub README with no Actions workflows.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Catalog site first, then generated GitHub README, then origin stub publish (unblocks live README proof and Actions badges), then maintainer Starlight, Copier Starlight/CSS, plugin webview, kit HTML last.

options.label: Catalog site (src/awesome_iina/site → dist/site)
Generated GitHub README (README.md.j2)
Maintainer Starlight (starter/site, kit tokens allowed)
Copier Starlight/CSS (zinc/blue only; no catalog identity)
Plugin webview (starter template src/ui)
Kit HTML (START-HERE.html / review/index.html)
GitHub origin stub publish (live README + Actions badge.svg)

questions.prompt: Which catalog P1s are in-scope this goal?
questions.description: Start here is 19 rows (~1748px) above #filters, so search is not in the first viewport. Light Reset/Catalog-label borders are 2.96:1 on --card (need ≥3:1). Dark already passes. Recommend both.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Both: move search/filters above Start here, and raise light-theme control contrast to ≥3:1.

options.label: Move search/filters above Start here
Light-theme control contrast ≥3:1 (border and/or button fill)

questions.prompt: How dense should Start here be on the catalog site and the generated README?
questions.description: One catalog.yaml featured set drives both. design.md wants a short name + one-liner list, not a second catalog. Today: 19 featured (10 active, 9 unknown).
questions.recommendedAnswer: Shrink featured to a short onboarding list (~5–8 name + one-liner) on both catalog and README; leave the rest in provenance / Curated ecosystem only.

options.label: Short featured list (~5–8 name + one-liner) on catalog AND README
Keep 19 featured rows on catalog AND README

questions.prompt: Which README P1s should this goal fix (unselected = document only)?
questions.description: Awesome badge still links awesome.re though the list is not a listing. Four Actions badge.svg URLs 404 because origin has no workflows. lint-awesome does not resolve picture/srcset/img (paths exist today).
questions.recommendedAnswer: Fix all three: relink Awesome badge to the list policy (keep the image if local lint requires it); omit 404 Actions chips until origin workflows exist, then keep native GitHub badge URLs; extend lint-awesome to resolve picture/srcset/img.

options.label: Fix: relink Awesome badge away from awesome.re (keep image if lint requires)
Fix: omit 404 Actions chips until origin workflows exist (native URLs after publish)
Fix: lint-awesome resolves picture/srcset/img paths

questions.prompt: How far should this goal beautify in-scope surfaces?
questions.description: Stay on existing kit tokens. Catalog remains vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (no React, no bundler). Theme control stays named Dark theme. Not a kit artwork rewrite.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Noticeable visual polish within existing kit tokens (spacing, type, chrome, density) plus the contrast/IA/a11y P1s — not a new visual language.

options.label: Restrained refine: contrast, IA, and a11y only
Noticeable visual polish within existing kit tokens

questions.prompt: Confirm these stay out of scope.
questions.description: Locked: no React/shadcn on the catalog; catalog stays provenance-grouped (not category regroup); not an awesome.re submission; kit artwork is SSOT and is not redrawn here. Uncheck any item that should become in-scope.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All four remain out of scope.

options.label: No React / shadcn on the catalog
Do not regroup the catalog by category
No awesome.re listing submission
Do not rewrite kit artwork
